00638: function getMonthNames(locale: string) {
00639:   const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
00640:     month: "long",
00641:   });
00642: 
00643:   return Array.from(
00644:     { length: 12 },
00645:     (_, month) =>
00646:       formatter.format(
00647:         new Date(2026, month, 1),
00648:       ),
00649:   );
00650: }
00651: 
00652: 
00653: function getDayNames(locale: string) {
00654:   const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
00655:     weekday: "short",
00656:   });
00657: 
00658:   const sunday = new Date(2026, 0, 4);
00659: 
00660:   return Array.from(
00661:     { length: 7 },
00662:     (_, index) => {
00663:       const date = new Date(sunday);
00664: 
00665:       date.setDate(
00666:         sunday.getDate() + index,
00667:       );
00668: 
00669:       return formatter.format(date);
00670:     },
00671:   );
00672: }

00710: function getCalendarDays(year: number, month: number) {
00711:   const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
00712:   const numberOfDays = new Date(
00713:     year,
00714:     month + 1,
00715:     0,
00716:   ).getDate();
00717: 
00718:   const result: Array<number | null> = [];
00719: 
00720:   for (let index = 0; index < firstDay; index += 1) {
00721:     result.push(null);
00722:   }
00723: 
00724:   for (let day = 1; day <= numberOfDays; day += 1) {
00725:     result.push(day);
00726:   }
00727: 
00728:   while (result.length % 7 !== 0) {
00729:     result.push(null);
00730:   }
00731: 
00732:   return result;
00733: }
